Glossier’s **[Boy Brow](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462853136268927,imageDocid:8211653089142462009,gpcid:15450130591034416802,headlineOfferDocid:12603349050905840215,catalogid:4707051696100372425,productDocid:7395767060593493446,rds:PC_15450130591034416802%7CPROD_PC_15450130591034416802&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiE1vem64OYAxXaAfsDHaSuLBUQxa4PeggIAggBCA4QAQ)** remains `a cult-favorite grooming pomade/gel, famous for giving a soft, fluffy, "undone-done" look with minimal effort`.[[1]](https://www.glossier.com/products/boy-brow)[[2]](https://hypebae.com/2025/11/glossier-boy-brow-gel-review-where-to-buy)

#### **The Lowdown** 

- **Price:** $22 on the [Glossier Official Website](https://www.glossier.com/products/boy-brow) 
- **Size:** 0.13 oz / 3.8 g
- **Finish:** Soft, flexible hold (never crunchy, stiff, or flaky)
- **Shade Range:** Clear, Blond, Auburn, Brown, Dark Brown, Grey, and Black
- **Key Ingredients:** Beeswax, Carnauba Wax, Oleic Acid, Lecithin, and Hyaluronic Acid for a conditioning, pomade-like texture.[[1]](https://hypebae.com/2025/11/glossier-boy-brow-gel-review-where-to-buy)[[2]](https://www.glossier.com/products/boy-brow)

#### **Pros & Cons** 

**What People Love:** 

- **Foolproof Application:** The mini spoolie coats even the finest, shortest baby hairs without depositing a massive glob of product.
- **Natural Texture:** Unlike heavy-duty hair-gel style brow setters, it stays touchably soft while still locking hairs roughly in place.
- **Great Solo or Layered:** You can wear it completely on its own for a quick, bushy, no-makeup look, or swipe it over a pencil/powder as a final setting step.[[1]](https://www.glossier.com/products/boy-brow)[[2]](https://hypebae.com/2025/11/glossier-boy-brow-gel-review-where-to-buy)

**Where It Falls Short:** 

- **Not for Extreme Hold:** If you want laminated, rock-solid "soap brows" that stay glued upward through a hurricane, this isn't strong enough.
- **Light Coverage:** The tinted versions add subtle color and fullness, but they won't fill in large gaps or sparse patches on their own.
- **Tube Size:** Because of the creamy consistency, some users feel like you go through a tube relatively fast with daily use.[[1]](https://www.glossier.com/products/boy-brow)

#### **The Verdict** 

- **Rating:** ≈ 4.4 / 5 stars across thousands of user reviews.
- **Best for:** People who love a fast, natural, fluffy brow and hate the stiff feeling of traditional brow gels.[[1]](https://www.glossier.com/products/boy-brow)[[2]](https://hypebae.com/2025/11/glossier-boy-brow-gel-review-where-to-buy)
